newsitem.title: USA: Vermont unemployment rate for May at 3.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vermont unemployment rate for May at 3.8 pct.

text.p: The seasonally adjusted state unemployment rate for Vermont was 3.8 percent for May, down one tenth of a point from the April estimate, the Department of Employment and Training announced Tuesday.

Unemployment rates for Vermont's 13 labor market areas ranged from 1.6 percent in the Hartford-Lebanon area to 6.8 percent in Newport. Labor market rates are not seasonally adjusted. For comparison, the department said, the unadjusted rate for Vermont was 3.6 percent.
